title: Building Domain-Specific LLMs Faithful To The Islamic Worldview: Mirage or Technical Possibility?
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured the ability of Large Language Models to generate responses that are faithful to the Islamic worldview, by assessing the semantic and structural similarity of model outputs to expert-generated answers from Islamic sources like IslamQA.
findings: The study found that few-shot prompting was the most effective method across all tested models (GPT-3.5, GPT-4, LLAMA-7B, LLAMA-70B), with GPT-4 showing a marginal advantage. While Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) with a Hadith dataset did not significantly improve performance, fine-tuning the GPT-3.5 model on domain-specific datasets (Hadith and Islamic Q&A) resulted in noticeable performance gains, achieving the highest F1-score and lowest embedding distance.
